title: SDK clinic: observability & samples roundup — Jul 14 2026
body:
Attendees: Aisha, Liam, Priya, Marco (10m standup + 30m triage)

Purpose: weekly health clinic focused on SDK telemetry gaps, failing samples, and quickstart friction observed in onboarding playbook. Intended outcome: 1) triage most pressing flakes 2) agree rollout plan for improved observability events 3) decide which samples to deprecate/mothball.

Summary notes:
- Telemetry: current SDK telemetry (v0.9.2) is missing per-route latency tags when streaming is enabled. Repro steps from Marco: run quickstart-chat with streaming=true, check telemetry payload — traces show total request time but no per-chunk metric. Root cause hypothesis: streaming path bypasses metrics wrapper in client.js.
  - Action: Liam to open a small patch that wraps streaming chunk handler with observeSpan (ETA 2 days). Jira: DEVEXP-1218 assigned to Liam.

- Samples health: sample-gist-agent demonstrates token overflow on long prompts (seen in CI flaky job #samples-smoke-17). Failure pattern: sample doesn't set max_tokens and uses naive append loop causing runaway input size.
  - Immediate fix: add guard in JS/py samples to enforce prompt trimming and a top-level max_tokens in sample harness. Priya to submit PR to sdk-examples (PR template ready). Priority: high for onboarding retention.

- Quickstarts: new user funnel shows 32% drop-off between tokenization step and first SDK call in the field trial (internal analytics). Suspected causes: unclear env var instructions and non-obvious PATH requirements for local grpc plugin.
  - Short term: update Quickstart README with explicit steps and a one-liner install. Aisha will draft copy and run it by docs team.
  - Medium term: create an automated ‘first-run’ validation script that runs smoke sample and returns a friendly error mapping (ticket: DEVEXP-1223). Marco to prototype next week.

- Observability roadmap alignment: product wants token-level cost breakdown in console by end of Q3. We identified three missing pieces in SDK: event for tokens-per-chunk, event for cache-hit, and metadata that links SDK session -> Console route id.
  - Proposal: add optional context param to all Request classes: {route_id, session_id}. Backwards compatible — default null. Team agreed. Liam to draft API sketch and call out breaking considerations.

- Mothball candidates (samples we probably remove from official quickstarts):
  - sample-image-annotator (low usage, high maintenance)
  - sample-vector-store-demo (duplicative with new embeddings cookbook)
  - sample-gist-agent (keep after fix)
  - Decision: deprecate first two, add clear deprecation notices, create archived folder + migration notes. Priya to prepare deprecation PR and archive plan.

Blockers and risks:
- Need for cross-team sign-off on telemetry schema changes. Observability team wants a proto change submitted with backward-translation layer. Liaise: @observability-systems (TBD).
- Time pressure: dedicated capacity release next week reduces window for larger SDK compatibility changes. Keep breaking changes minimal.

Action items (owner — ETA):
- Liam: open PR to wrap streaming handler in metrics wrapper (2d) — Jira DEVEXP-1218.
- Priya: PR for prompt trimming guard in samples + update smoke test (3d).
- Aisha: Quickstart README one-liner + “first-run” checklist for docs review (1d).
- Marco: prototype first-run validation script and sketch error-to-fix mapping (EOD next Wednesday).
- Priya: deprecation PR for two samples + archive folder plan (5d).

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Remember to ping security about session_id propagation — ensure we don't leak PII in telemetry (check with compliance).
- Keep feature flags in place for telemetry until console schema is stable.

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Quick sync next Tue 07/21 — focus: review streaming telemetry PR and sample PRs.
- Invite Observability and Console PM for a 20m alignment slot the week after (Aisha to schedule).

Random fragments / brainstorming (informal):
- Could we provide a tiny local dashboard in the CLI that prints token usage per-run? Nice for dev experience, quick to implement as local aggregation. Low-friction beta.
- Consider 'first-run' telemetry opt-in popup in CLI so we can measure where people drop off in onboarding (needs legal/PM OK).

References and links (copied into ticket):
- CI failure logs: ci://samples-smoke/job-17
- Example failing run: s3://devexp/samples/failures/2026-07-12/gist-agent-001.log
- Draft PR (samples): github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples/pull/488 (Priya)

End of notes.

Quick status snapshot (numbers):
- Open SDK issues related to DX: 7 (3 high, 2 medium, 2 low)
- Samples flakiness rate (last 30d): 4.7% -> target <1%
- Onboarding funnel first-week retention (field trial cohort): 68% -> target 80%

If anything here should be moved to a formal roadmap or RFC, call it out in comments below.
